mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}
SELECT CONTENT_ID FROM CONTENT WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} FOR UPDATE WAIT 5
SELECT USER_ID FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND BAN_YN = 'N' FOR UPDATE WAIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CREATED_AT > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '1' SECOND AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE(CONTENT_ID, USER_ID, BODY) VALUES(#{contentId}, #{userId}, #{body})
mapper.sql: M.MESSAGE_ID, M.CONTENT_ID, U.USER_ID, COALESCE(U.USERNAME, '탈퇴한 사용자') NICKNAME, U.PROFILE_IMAGE_KEY IMAGE_KEY, M.BODY, M.CREATED_AT
FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.BAN_YN = 'N'
